WITH first_usage AS (
  -- Визначаємо перший раз, коли кожен користувач використав певний функціонал (event_type)
  SELECT 
    amplitude_id AS user_identifier,
    event_type,
    MIN(DATE(client_upload_time)) AS first_usage_date
  FROM `analytics-454817.bigquery.EVENTS_407641`
  GROUP BY user_identifier, event_type
),
subsequent_usage AS (
  -- Для кожного користувача та функціоналу знаходимо дату наступного використання після першого
  SELECT 
    e.amplitude_id AS user_identifier,
    e.event_type,
    MIN(DATE(client_upload_time)) AS second_usage_date
  FROM `analytics-454817.bigquery.EVENTS_407641` e
  JOIN first_usage f 
    ON e.amplitude_id = f.user_identifier 
   AND e.event_type = f.event_type
  WHERE DATE(client_upload_time) > f.first_usage_date
  GROUP BY e.amplitude_id, e.event_type
)
SELECT 
  f.event_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.user_identifier) AS first_users,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.user_identifier) AS returning_users,
  AVG(DATE_DIFF(s.second_usage_date, f.first_usage_date, DAY)) AS avg_return_offset_days
FROM first_usage f
LEFT JOIN subsequent_usage s 
  ON f.user_identifier = s.user_identifier 
 AND f.event_type = s.event_type
GROUP BY f.event_type
ORDER BY returning_users DESC;

-- 1) Всі події, де є phone_number
WITH phone_events AS (
  SELECT
    amplitude_id,
    JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(user_properties, '$.phone_number') AS phone,
    client_upload_time
  FROM `analytics-454817.bigquery.EVENTS_407641`
  WHERE
    JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(user_properties, '$.phone_number') IS NOT NULL
    AND JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(user_properties, '$.phone_number') != ''
),

-- 2) Для кожного amplitude_id отримуємо тільки останню телефонну подію
latest_phone_per_user AS (
  SELECT
    amplitude_id,
    phone
  FROM (
    SELECT
      amplitude_id,
      phone,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER(
        PARTITION BY amplitude_id
        ORDER BY client_upload_time DESC
      ) AS rn
    FROM phone_events
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
),

-- 3) Для кожного phone знаходимо канонічний amplitude_id
canonical_map AS (
  SELECT
    phone,
    MIN(amplitude_id) AS canonical_amplitude_id
  FROM latest_phone_per_user
  GROUP BY phone
),

-- 4) Мапа: кожному amplitude_id зі списку latest_phone_per_user даємо unified_amplitude_id
mapped_users AS (
  SELECT
    lpu.amplitude_id,
    cm.canonical_amplitude_id,
    lpu.phone
  FROM latest_phone_per_user AS lpu
  JOIN canonical_map AS cm
    ON lpu.phone = cm.phone
)

-- 5) Фінальний вибір: додаємо два стовпці до оригінальних подій
SELECT
  -- якщо для амплітюди є mapped — підставляємо canonical, інакше залишаємо оригінал
  IFNULL(mu.canonical_amplitude_id, e.amplitude_id) AS unified_amplitude_id,
  mu.phone                                                  AS phone,
  e.*  -- всі інші поля з таблиці подій
FROM `analytics-454817.bigquery.EVENTS_407641` AS e
LEFT JOIN mapped_users AS mu
  ON e.amplitude_id = mu.amplitude_id;

SELECT 
  event_type,
  COUNT(*) AS event_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT amplitude_id) AS unique_users
FROM `analytics-454817.bigquery.EVENTS_407641`
GROUP BY event_type
ORDER BY event_count DESC;

WITH user_events AS (
  SELECT 
    amplitude_id AS user_identifier,
    DATE(client_upload_time) AS event_date
  FROM `analytics-454817.bigquery.EVENTS_407641`
),
cohorts AS (
  SELECT 
    user_identifier,
    MIN(event_date) AS cohort_date
  FROM user_events
  GROUP BY user_identifier
)
SELECT 
  cohort_date AS event_date,
  COUNT(*) AS new_users
FROM cohorts
GROUP BY cohort_date
ORDER BY cohort_date DESC

WITH events AS (
  SELECT
    JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(user_properties, '$.phone_number') AS phone,
    event_type,
    version_name,
    client_event_time
  FROM `analytics-454817.bigquery.EVENTS_407641`
  WHERE JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(user_properties, '$.phone_number') IS NOT NULL
),

sequence_events AS (
  SELECT
    phone,
    event_type,
    LAG(event_type) OVER (
      PARTITION BY phone
      ORDER BY client_event_time
    ) AS prev_event
  FROM events
),

sequence_counts AS (
  SELECT
    phone,
    COUNT(*) AS sequence_count
  FROM sequence_events
  WHERE prev_event = 'auth_pin_create_scrn_repeat_view'
    AND event_type = 'news_scrn__view'
  GROUP BY phone
),

last_versions AS (
  SELECT
    phone,
    version_name AS last_version
  FROM (
    SELECT
      phone,
      version_name,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY phone
        ORDER BY client_event_time DESC
      ) AS rn
    FROM events
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
)

SELECT
  sc.phone,
  sc.sequence_count,
  lv.last_version
FROM sequence_counts AS sc
LEFT JOIN last_versions AS lv
  ON sc.phone = lv.phone
ORDER BY sc.sequence_count DESC;

WITH user_events AS (
  SELECT 
    amplitude_id AS user_identifier,
    DATE(client_upload_time) AS event_date
  FROM `analytics-454817.bigquery.EVENTS_407641`
),
cohorts AS (
  SELECT 
    user_identifier,
    MIN(event_date) AS cohort_date
  FROM user_events
  GROUP BY user_identifier
),
activity AS (
  SELECT 
    u.user_identifier,
    u.event_date,
    DATE_DIFF(u.event_date, c.cohort_date, DAY) AS day_offset,
    c.cohort_date
  FROM user_events u
  JOIN cohorts c ON u.user_identifier = c.user_identifier
)
SELECT
  cohort_date,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN day_offset = 0 THEN user_identifier END) AS D0,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN day_offset = 1 THEN user_identifier END) AS D1,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN day_offset = 2 THEN user_identifier END) AS D2,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN day_offset = 3 THEN user_identifier END) AS D3,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN day_offset = 4 THEN user_identifier END) AS D4,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN day_offset = 5 THEN user_identifier END) AS D5,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN day_offset = 6 THEN user_identifier END) AS D6,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN day_offset = 7 THEN user_identifier END) AS D7,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN day_offset = 8 THEN user_identifier END) AS D8,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN day_offset = 9 THEN user_identifier END) AS D9,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN day_offset = 10 THEN user_identifier END) AS D10,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN day_offset = 11 THEN user_identifier END) AS D11,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN day_offset = 12 THEN user_identifier END) AS D12,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN day_offset = 13 THEN user_identifier END) AS D13
FROM activity
WHERE day_offset BETWEEN 0 AND 13
GROUP BY cohort_date
ORDER BY cohort_date DESC;

WITH users_with_phone AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT 
    amplitude_id,
    JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(user_properties, '$.phone_number') AS phone_number
  FROM `analytics-454817.bigquery.EVENTS_407641`
  WHERE 
    JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(user_properties, '$.phone_number') IS NOT NULL
    AND JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(user_properties, '$.phone_number') != ''
)

SELECT 
  e.*, 
  u.phone_number
FROM `analytics-454817.bigquery.EVENTS_407641` e
JOIN users_with_phone u
ON e.amplitude_id = u.amplitude_id
